What size frame fits a printable? 4 × 6, 5 × 7, Letter and A4

November 26, 2026 · By Kimberly Marnell

A printable is only as good as the frame you put it in. The good news is that the common printable sizes all match standard frames you can buy anywhere. Here is which frame and mat to look for, size by size, with the downloads from my Haven Art House shop as examples.

First, print at the size the file was made for

Whatever frame you choose, print at 100% / Actual Size. Turn off "Fit to page" or "Scale to fit" in the print dialog, or the image will shrink and no longer match the frame. Print one test page on plain paper and hold it against the frame's backing board before you use good paper.

4 × 6 in prints

A 4 × 6 print fits a standard 4 × 6 photo frame edge to edge. For more presence, use a 5 × 7 frame with a mat cut for 4 × 6, or an 8 × 10 frame with a 4 × 6 mat for a wide white border that looks gallery-like on a desk or shelf. Mat openings are cut slightly smaller than the print, about 3.5 × 5.5 in, so the mat overlaps the edges and holds the print flat.

Example: the Palm Photography Pair, two printable 4 × 6 prints ($8).

5 × 7 in prints

A 5 × 7 print fits a standard 5 × 7 frame. Step up to an 8 × 10 frame with a 5 × 7 mat for a classic look, or an 11 × 14 frame with a 5 × 7 mat if you want a small image to hold its own on a wall.

In the Figurative Art Trio ($12), each print already has a white border with a small title and credit, so the painting itself is smaller than 5 × 7. A plain 5 × 7 frame with no mat already looks finished, and if you do add a mat, it will cover part of the border rather than the art. The trio includes Queen of the Night, Flourish and Going Home, and comes as an exact-size file plus Letter and A4 sheets with corner marks for trimming.

The Quiet Moments Notecards ($9) are folded 5 × 7 cards. They're meant to be written in and sent, but a favorite front also fits a 5 × 7 frame once the card is cut along the fold.

US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) pages

Letter is not the same as the common 8 × 10 frame size, so an 8 × 10 frame will crop it. Look for a frame sold as 8.5 × 11 (often called a document or certificate frame), or use an 11 × 14 frame with a mat cut for 8.5 × 11. A standard 11 × 14 frame with an 8 × 10 mat will hide the edges of a Letter page.

A4 (210 × 297 mm) pages

A4 is slightly narrower and taller than Letter, about 8.3 × 11.7 in. Frames sold as A4 fit it exactly; they're standard in the UK, Europe and Australia and easy to order in the US. Otherwise use a 30 × 40 cm or 12 × 16 in frame with an A4 mat.

Calendars: clip, don't frame

A calendar works best where you can flip the pages. My 2027 Printable Wall Calendar ($12) comes in US Letter and A4 versions, with a painting on every month. Clip or bind the pages and hang them from a small nail or a clipboard. The full how-to, from paper to settings to hanging, is in the Haven Art House printing guide.

Paper

For prints you plan to frame, a heavier matte paper or cardstock gives the best color and stays flat behind glass. Colors vary a little between printers and screens, so a test print is always worth it.
